India A Dominates Sri Lanka A in Unofficial Test Match

Sai Sudharsan scored a century, contributing significantly to India A's strong position against Sri Lanka A in the second unofficial Test. Other Indian batsmen also posted half-centuries, while bowlers Saransh Jain and Gurinder Singh took wickets. India A has established a substantial lead in the match.
